hints.title: Evaluate Total XOR Sum
hints.text: Compute total exclusive-or sum of all integers from 1 to n.

hints.title: XOR of All Elements Except First
hints.text: Because n is odd, XORing encoded[1], encoded[3], ..., encoded[n - 2] covers perm[1] through perm[n - 1].

hints.title: Isolate First Element
hints.text: XORing total with the odd-index encoded reduction yields perm[0]. Then decode remaining elements sequentially.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of decoded permutation
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all n! permutations is infeasible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise parity decomposition computes perm[0] in O(n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate pairs odd encoded entries to eliminate perm[1..n-1] from total XOR.
